def parse_args():
    p = argparse.ArgumentParser(
        description="Convert cell masks to polylines with MobileSAM."
    )
    p.add_argument(
        "--weights_path",
        "--weights-path",
        dest="weights_path",
        type=str,
        required=True,
        help="Path to MobileSAM weights (mobile_sam.pt).",
    )
    p.add_argument(
        "--output_path",
        "--output-path",
        dest="output_path",
        type=str,
        required=True,
        help="Output folder (or .csv file path) for the refined masks.",
    )
